notes:
v1.5.3 Update
- Fixed Scene Recall images staying cropped when scaled down. All six themes can now show the full image when scaled down far enough.
- Kept existing animations and framing at 100% or higher. Image scale and position edits still update the preview immediately.

announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.5.3
announcement.content:
Scene Recall Image Scaling

  • Reducing the image scale now reveals the original image's edges, so the full image can fit in the panel. This works across all six themes, including wide and tall images.
  • Existing animations and framing at 100% or higher are preserved. Scale and position edits update the open preview immediately.
